title: Headless tutorial hints (CGTutorial): the hint stages for low health, a crippled limb, an addiction and a worn-out weapon (200, 210, 212, 216, 218)

actions.text: Path: from a new game, VCGTutorialSCRIPT's GameMode block sets a hint stage the first time the player's state meets it [observed, decompiled script]: health below half (200), a limb condition at 0 (210), and in its MenuMode 1 block (the Pip-Boy open) the same (212), Times Addicted above 0 (216), the equipped weapon's health below 25% (218). 220 (200 rads) is reached by other chains. Not reached here: 52 (needs 50, which nothing sets), 214 (Locations Discovered 4: map-marker discovery is the play engine's, not headless; ShowMap does not count), 72 and 92 (need the tutorial's VATS and sneak steps). Stand-ins: the damage by damage_av (a fall or a fight); the Jet bought and taken six times (consume; the addiction roll is the engine's seeded one); the worn weapon given at 10% health by AddItemHealthPercent and equipped.
Stand-in for a hard fight: 150 health lost of 200.
Stand-in for a crippling blow to the head.
The player opens the Pip-Boy (its inventory, a MenuMode 1 menu) with the limb still crippled: the MenuMode 1 block sets 212.
Stand-in for chems bought and taken until the player is hooked.
Stand-in for a weapon worn down by use: a 9mm pistol at 10% health, equipped.
